# Load packages

Install the necessary packages for our analysis.  The function 'require' returns a true value if it is already installed, so if it is not, we need to install before loading

```{r Packages, warning=FALSE}

library(RRHO)
library(ggplot2)

```


# Sex diff genes

```{r}

sex_diff_norm_file = "/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/dream_diffexpr_norm_femalemale_batchcorr.csv"
sex_diff_norm_data = read.csv(sex_diff_norm_file)

sex_diff_hyp_file = "/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/dream_diffexpr_hyp_femalemale_batchcorr.csv"
sex_diff_hyp_data = read.csv(sex_diff_hyp_file)

```

# Change in norm vs hyp

```{r normhyp}

male_hypnorm_file = "/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/dream_diffexpr_male_hypnorm_batchcorr.csv"
male_hypnorm_data = read.csv(male_hypnorm_file)
male_hypnorm_data$logFC = -1 * male_hypnorm_data$logFC # fixed so that the orientation is hyp / norm

female_hypnorm_file = "/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/dream_diffexpr_female_hypnorm_batchcorr.csv"
female_hypnorm_data = read.csv(female_hypnorm_file)
female_hypnorm_data$logFC = -1 * female_hypnorm_data$logFC

```

# Get other data sets for comparison

```{r others}

Horii_male_hypnorm_data = read.csv("/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/Horii/male_normhyp_DEG_dge_all_expressed_genes.csv")
Horii_female_hypnorm_data = read.csv("/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/Horii/female_normhyp_DEG_dge_all_expressed_genes.csv")

Smith_male_hypnorm_data = read.csv("/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/Smith/13293_2025_781_MOESM13_ESM_males.csv")
Smith_female_hypnorm_data = read.csv("/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/Smith/13293_2025_781_MOESM14_ESM_females.csv")

Horii_norm_sexdiff_data = read.csv("/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/Horii/norm_sexdiff_sgaCovar_DEG_all_expressed_genes.csv")
Horii_hyp_sexdiff_data = read.csv("/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/Horii/hyp_sexdiff_sgaCovar_DEG_all_expressed_genes.csv")

Smith_norm_sexdiff_data = ""
Smith_hyp_sexdiff_data = ""

```

# RRHO

```{r normhyp}

#  ------------------------- Norm/Ctrl vs Hyp/PE ---------------------------

#  ------------------------- Valleywise vs Horii ---------------------------
# use sign log p as score

male_hypnorm_data$signlogp = ifelse(male_hypnorm_data$logFC >= 0, -log10(male_hypnorm_data$P.Value), log10(male_hypnorm_data$P.Value))
female_hypnorm_data$signlogp = ifelse(female_hypnorm_data$logFC >= 0, -log10(female_hypnorm_data$P.Value), log10(female_hypnorm_data$P.Value))

Horii_male_hypnorm_data$signlogp = ifelse(Horii_male_hypnorm_data$logFC >= 0, -log10(Horii_male_hypnorm_data$P.Value), log10(Horii_male_hypnorm_data$P.Value))
Horii_female_hypnorm_data$signlogp = ifelse(Horii_female_hypnorm_data$logFC >= 0, -log10(Horii_female_hypnorm_data$P.Value), log10(Horii_female_hypnorm_data$P.Value))

# RRHO map of gene symbols in both data sets

#  ------- males -------
overlapping_genes_male = intersect(male_hypnorm_data$genes, Horii_male_hypnorm_data$symbol)

list1 = male_hypnorm_data[male_hypnorm_data$genes %in% overlapping_genes_male, colnames(male_hypnorm_data) %in% c("genes","signlogp")]
colnames(list1) = c("symbol","signlogp")
list1 =  list1[order(list1$signlogp, decreasing = TRUE), ]

list2 = Horii_male_hypnorm_data[Horii_male_hypnorm_data$symbol %in% overlapping_genes_male, colnames(Horii_male_hypnorm_data) %in% c("symbol","signlogp")]
list2 =  list2[order(abs(list2$signlogp), decreasing = TRUE), ] # collapse by abs signlogp
list2 = list2[!duplicated(list2$symbol), ] # remove duplicate genes
list2 =  list2[order(list2$signlogp, decreasing = TRUE), ]

rrho_results = RRHO(
    list1,
    list2,
    alternative = "enrichment",
    stepsize = 100,
    BY = TRUE,
    plots = TRUE,
    outputdir = "/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/Horii/",
    labels = c("Valleywise_male_normhyp", "Horii_male_ctrlPE")
)

merge_results = merge(list1,list2, by = "symbol")
ggplot(merge_results, aes(x = signlogp.x, y = signlogp.y)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  xlab("Valleywise Norm vs Hyp in Male placenta (signlog p)") +
  ylab("Horii Ctrl vs PE in Male placenta (signlog p)") +
  theme_minimal()
  
#  ------- females -------
overlapping_genes_female = intersect(female_hypnorm_data$genes, Horii_female_hypnorm_data$symbol)

list1 = female_hypnorm_data[female_hypnorm_data$genes %in% overlapping_genes_female, colnames(female_hypnorm_data) %in% c("genes","signlogp")]
colnames(list1) = c("symbol","signlogp")
list1 =  list1[order(list1$signlogp, decreasing = TRUE), ]

list2 = Horii_female_hypnorm_data[Horii_female_hypnorm_data$symbol %in% overlapping_genes_female, colnames(Horii_female_hypnorm_data) %in% c("symbol","signlogp")]
list2 =  list2[order(abs(list2$signlogp), decreasing = TRUE), ] # collapse by abs signlogp
list2 = list2[!duplicated(list2$symbol), ] # remove duplicate genes
list2 =  list2[order(list2$signlogp, decreasing = TRUE), ]

rrho_results = RRHO(
    list1,
    list2,
    alternative = "enrichment",
    stepsize = 100,
    BY = TRUE,
    plots = TRUE,
    outputdir = "/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/Horii/",
    labels = c("Valleywise_female_normhyp", "Horii_female_ctrlPE")
)

merge_results = merge(list1,list2, by = "symbol")
ggplot(merge_results, aes(x = signlogp.x, y = signlogp.y)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  xlab("Valleywise Norm vs Hyp in Female placenta (signlog p)") +
  ylab("Horii Ctrl vs PE in Female placenta (signlog p)") +
  theme_minimal()

#  ------------------------- Valleywise vs Smith ---------------------------

# use sign log p as score
Smith_male_hypnorm_data$signlogp = ifelse(Smith_male_hypnorm_data$logFC >= 0, -log10(Smith_male_hypnorm_data$P.Value), log10(Smith_male_hypnorm_data$P.Value))
Smith_female_hypnorm_data$signlogp = ifelse(Smith_female_hypnorm_data$logFC >= 0, -log10(Smith_female_hypnorm_data$P.Value), log10(Smith_female_hypnorm_data$P.Value))

# RRHO map of gene symbols in both data sets

#  ------- males -------
overlapping_genes_male = intersect(male_hypnorm_data$genes, Smith_male_hypnorm_data$hgnc_symbol)

list1 = male_hypnorm_data[male_hypnorm_data$genes %in% overlapping_genes_male, colnames(male_hypnorm_data) %in% c("genes","signlogp")]
colnames(list1) = c("symbol","signlogp")
list1 =  list1[order(list1$signlogp, decreasing = TRUE), ]

list2 = Smith_male_hypnorm_data[Smith_male_hypnorm_data$hgnc_symbol %in% overlapping_genes_male, colnames(Smith_male_hypnorm_data) %in% c("hgnc_symbol","signlogp")]
colnames(list2) = c("symbol","signlogp")
# list2 = list2[order(abs(list2$signlogp), decreasing = TRUE), ] # collapse by abs signlogp
# list2 = list2[!duplicated(list2$symbol), ] # remove duplicate genes
list2 =  list2[order(list2$signlogp, decreasing = TRUE), ]

rrho_results = RRHO(
    list1,
    list2,
    alternative = "enrichment",
    stepsize = 100,
    BY = TRUE,
    plots = TRUE,
    outputdir = "/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/Smith/",
    labels = c("Valleywise_male_normhyp", "Smith_male_ctrlPE")
)

merge_results = merge(list1,list2, by = "symbol")
ggplot(merge_results, aes(x = signlogp.x, y = signlogp.y)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  xlab("Valleywise Norm vs Hyp in Male placenta (signlog p)") +
  ylab("Smith Ctrl vs PE in Male placenta (signlog p)") +
  theme_minimal()

#  ------- females -------
overlapping_genes_female = intersect(female_hypnorm_data$genes, Smith_female_hypnorm_data$hgnc_symbol)

list1 = female_hypnorm_data[female_hypnorm_data$genes %in% overlapping_genes_female, colnames(female_hypnorm_data) %in% c("genes","signlogp")]
colnames(list1) = c("symbol","signlogp")
list1 =  list1[order(list1$signlogp, decreasing = TRUE), ]

list2 = Smith_female_hypnorm_data[Smith_female_hypnorm_data$hgnc_symbol %in% overlapping_genes_female, colnames(Smith_female_hypnorm_data) %in% c("hgnc_symbol","signlogp")]
colnames(list2) = c("symbol","signlogp")
list2 =  list2[order(abs(list2$signlogp), decreasing = TRUE), ] # collapse by abs signlogp
list2 = list2[!duplicated(list2$symbol), ] # remove duplicate genes
list2 =  list2[order(list2$signlogp, decreasing = TRUE), ]

rrho_results = RRHO(
    list1,
    list2,
    alternative = "enrichment",
    stepsize = 100,
    BY = TRUE,
    plots = TRUE,
    outputdir = "/data/Wilson_Lab/projects/placenta_multiomics/valleywise_3samples/RRHO_other_datasets/Smith/",
    labels = c("Valleywise_female_normhyp", "Smith_female_ctrlPE")
)

merge_results = merge(list1,list2, by = "symbol")
ggplot(merge_results, aes(x = signlogp.x, y = signlogp.y)) + 
  geom_point() +

  ylab("Smith Ctrl vs PE in Female placenta (signlog p)") +
```
